what_we_redistribute: Supplier/beneficiary names and payment amounts from UK public bodies' published spend-over-£500 returns, frozen and shipped inside task images.
Counterparty organisation names from the same returns, used in the COORD track.
Nothing else: rules, thresholds, people, exception items, policy documents and all code are authored by us.
what_we_do_not_redistribute: The source CSVs themselves are NOT shipped. Only individual supplier names and amounts, extracted deterministically, appear in the task images.
